translations.idiomatic: He also submitted successive memorials on Jin Yuan, Zheng Qiqian, Chen Yijian, Xie Da, Han Xiang, Pu Dounan, and Wang Deming—all formerly entrusting themselves to private gates as their heart-and-belly, occupying key roads, men of whom public opinion gnashed teeth.

sentences.zh: 至論馬光祖奪情，總賦淮東，乃嵩之預為引例之地，乞勒令追服終喪，以補名教。

translations.literal: He also discussed Ma Guangzu seizing mourning and chief-assessing Huai East—land Songzhi had pre-arranged as a precedent case—and begged to order him to pursue full mourning to repair name and teaching.
translations.idiomatic: He also discussed Ma Guangzu seizing mourning and chief-assessing Huai East—land Songzhi had pre-arranged as a precedent case—and begged to order him to pursue full mourning to repair name and teaching.

sentences.zh: 帝嚐屬漢弼以進人才，退而條具以奏，皆時望所歸重。

translations.literal: The emperor once entrusted Hanbi to advance talent; retiring he listed items and memorialized—all were men of the time's hopes and weight.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once entrusted Hanbi to advance talent; retiring he listed items and memorialized—all were men of the time's hopes and weight.

sentences.zh: 漢弼以受知特異，而姦邪未盡屏汰，論議未能堅定為慮，遂感末疾，居亡何，遂卒。

translations.literal: Hanbi, because he received special trust yet depravity and evil were not fully swept away and discussion could not be firm, was anxious; he contracted a terminal illness and within not long died.
translations.idiomatic: Hanbi, because he received special trust yet depravity and evil were not fully swept away and discussion could not be firm, was anxious; he contracted a terminal illness and soon died.

sentences.zh: 特贈四官，未幾，賜官田五百畝、楮五千緡給其家，諡曰「忠」。

translations.literal: He was specially granted four ranks; before long, five hundred mu of official fields and five thousand strings of paper cash were given to his family, and he received the posthumous title "Loyal."
translations.idiomatic: He was specially granted four ranks; before long, five hundred mu of official fields and five thousand strings of paper cash were given to his family, and he received the posthumous title "Loyal."

sentences.zh: 漢弼之沒也，太學生蔡德潤等百七十有三人伏闕上書以為暴卒，而程公許著《漢弼墓銘》，亦與徐元杰並言，其旨微矣。

translations.literal: At Hanbi's death more than one hundred seventy Imperial University students such as Cai Derun prostrated at the palace gate memorializing that he died suddenly; Cheng Gongxu also wrote Hanbi's tomb inscription, speaking of him together with Xu Yuanjie—the meaning is subtle.
translations.idiomatic: At Hanbi's death more than one hundred seventy Imperial University students such as Cai Derun prostrated at the palace gate memorializing that he died suddenly; Cheng Gongxu also wrote Hanbi's tomb inscription, speaking of him together with Xu Yuanjie—the meaning is subtle.

sentences.zh: 論曰：唐張九齡、姜公輔，宋余靖皆出於嶺嶠之南，而為名世公卿，造物者曷嘗擇地而生賢哉？

translations.literal: The discussion says: Tang's Zhang Jiuling and Jiang Gongfu, Song's Yu Jing—all came from south of the Ling ranges yet became famous-generation chief ministers; how does the Creator choose land in producing worthies?
translations.idiomatic: The discussion says: Tang's Zhang Jiuling and Jiang Gongfu, Song's Yu Jing—all came from south of the Ling ranges yet became famous-generation chief ministers; how does the Creator choose land in producing worthies?

sentences.zh: 先王立賢無方，蓋為是也。

translations.literal: The former kings established worthies without limit—indeed it is for this.
translations.idiomatic: The former kings established worthies without limit—indeed it is for this.

sentences.zh: 番禺崔與之晚出，屹然大臣之風，卒與三子者方駕齊驅。

translations.literal: Panyu Cui Yuzhi rose late yet had the bearing of a great minister standing firm, and in the end matched the three men abreast in the race.
translations.idiomatic: Panyu Cui Yuzhi rose late yet had the bearing of a great minister standing firm, and in the end matched the three men abreast in the race.

sentences.zh: 洪咨夔、許奕直道正言於理宗在位之日。

translations.literal: Hong Zikui and Xu Yi spoke the straight way and correct words in the days of Emperor Lizong's reign.
translations.idiomatic: Hong Zikui and Xu Yi spoke the straight way and correct words in the days of Emperor Lizong's reign.

sentences.zh: 陳居仁見稱循吏，親結主知。

translations.literal: Chen Juren was called a model official and personally bound the ruler's trust.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Juren was called a model official and personally bound the ruler's trust.

sentences.zh: 劉漢弼抱忠以死，哀哉！

translations.literal: Liu Hanbi embraced loyalty and died—alas!
translations.idiomatic: Liu Hanbi embraced loyalty and died—alas!
